subject.title: [Bug]: Docker Install + Sandbox can't workspaceAccess at all

question: Should OpenClaw support validated host-path remapping for Docker Gateway/DooD sandbox managed mounts, or keep the documented identical host/container path requirement as the supported contract?
rationale: The choice changes sandbox bind-source trust boundaries, Docker setup compatibility, and whether the repair needs config/schema/doctor support, so automation should not pick it without maintainer intent.

options.title: Support Secure Remapping
options.body: Add a validated remapping contract for managed workspace, agent workspace, materialized skill, and browser mounts, with docs and live DooD proof.

options.title: Keep Identical Paths
options.body: Document and enforce that Docker Gateway deployments must mount the same host path inside the Gateway container, with doctor guidance for mismatches.

options.title: Land Narrow Skill Repair Only
options.body: Treat materialized-skill fixes as partial follow-up while keeping this canonical workspaceAccess contract issue open.

recommendation.title: Support Secure Remapping
recommendation.body: Add a validated remapping contract for managed workspace, agent workspace, materialized skill, and browser mounts, with docs and live DooD proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They already marked this issue canonical and recently worked in Docker sandbox runtime paths.
